title: American Monster
description:
S13 E10 — Double Take
A CEO at just 29, Jenea Harvison supports her husband as his dreams of becoming a football player falter; living in his wife's shadow soon proves too much for Roy Harvison, and the price will be more than one life.

title: American Monster
description:
S13 E03 — Weight Control
Ashley's new confidence enrages estranged husband Terry, who stalks her to a secluded lot, ready to reclaim control in the deadliest way.

title: Six Degrees of Murder
description:
S02 E08 — The Last Shot
Forty-two-year-old single father of four Richard Mannion is found shot to death in his home, and police suspect he may have been looking for love in all the wrong places.

title: Six Degrees of Murder
description:
S02 E04 — Ties That Bind
Forty-three-year old Diane Holik is selling her home to start a new life with her fiancé in Houston, then she misses a meeting at work and police are sent to her home, where they find her bruised and lifeless body.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E03 — The Evil Inside
Kerri Harris and her friend discover a camera secreted in the restroom at work; while police examine the evidence, Harris is stabbed to death in her office with her co-workers just a few feet away.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E05 — Never Predicted
When Andrea Farrington meets fellow employee Alex Kozak, she feels that romance could be on the horizon, then Farrington's hopeful feelings are replaced by suspicion and fear, leading to a final rejection that has fatal consequences.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E04 — Evil Blossoms
Alisha Bromfield's supervisor, Brian Cooper, promotes her to team leader, but his motives are not entirely pure; Bromfield stands her ground, letting Cooper know she doesn't want a relationship beyond a professional one.

title: Suspicious Minds
description:
S01 E06 — Whispers From the Woods
A Pennsylvania town is filled with suspicion after 19-year-old Erica Miller disappears without warning; her mother posts flyers around town, prompting one resident to question the unusual behavior of a family friend.

title: Suspicious Minds
description:
S01 E04 — Rumors in the Halls
Suspicion lands close to home when prom queen Aquilla Flood is found dead in her bedroom; while Aquilla's friends point detectives to three local teens, her own family endures intense questioning about the night this popular young woman died.

title: Suspicious Minds
description:
S01 E03 — Who Killed the Councilman?
Matt Garcia, a city councilman in California, is shot dead; drug dealers, political rivals, and even Matt's own father are all suspects.

title: Disappeared
description:
S10 E04 — The Long Drive Home
Jason Landry disappears while driving home for the holiday break; PI and retired FBI agent Abel Peña does his own investigation and suspects Jason may have been the victim of foul play.

title: Disappeared
description:
S10 E08 — New Mom Missing
On February 24th, 2021, Ciera Breland, a successful lawyer and new mom, disappears after she and her husband, Xavier, visit his mother in Georgia; as Ciera's family and investigators try to find her, they realize her perfect life isn't what it seems.

title: Disappeared
description:
S10 E06 — A Vanishing on the Border
A rumor swirls around the border town of Brownsville, Texas, that Kimberly Avila may have been kidnapped or murdered by a member of the cartel when she went missing on May 13, 2017.

title: Disappeared
description:
S10 E02 — Disappearance in the Desert
Daniel Robinson arrives at his work site in the desert in Buckeye, Arizona and reportedly acts strangely just before taking off in the middle of his shift, never to be seen again.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S04 E04 — Candy
Deep in the kudzu of Alabama, police get a call about the body of a young man burned beyond recognition; Detective Kevin Palmer turns to the victim's phone records and picks up on a plot to lure the victim.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S04 E09 — The Highway Hunter
A scene straight out of a horror film unfolds outside a Colorado police station, leaving one woman clinging to life and a second violently abducted; Det. Rick Archer soon uncovers a disturbing pattern that may have started a decade earlier.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S04 E06 — Torso
Amongst the ashes of a barn fire, N.C. investigators discover the remains of two dismembered women; agent Nick Deming must dig into the victims' personal lives to uncover a revenge scheme and a killer.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S04 E05 — The Rose Tattoo
The body of a South Carolina man turns up floating in the Black River. Investigator Allen Morris, working his first homicide case, must scrutinize the victim's wife and mistress and ultimately untangle the web of deceit surrounding his disappearance.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S06 E11 — Natural Born Killers
In May 2002, a couple goes missing in Ocean City, Maryland, almost as if they vanished into thin air, until a random, late-night burglary leads police to discover a tale of deception, brutality and savagery.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S06 E05 — The Colorado Hammer Killer - Part 1
In 1984, a slew of brutal hammer attacks leaves a Colorado community in fear; it takes nearly 40 years before a serial killer is brought to justice.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S06 E05 — The Colorado Hammer Killer - Part 2
Vanessa Bennett saw her family murdered by a hammer wielding stranger when she was three years old; on April 7, 2022, a Jefferson County jury found 61-year-old Alex Ewing guilty of killing Patricia Smith in early 1984.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S06 E13 — Candy and Betty
When neighbors find a young teacher axed to death on Friday the 13th, a sleepy suburb fears a psychopath is loose; the bloody crime scene leads police to a most unlikely suspect, unfolding a story people still have to see to believe 40 years later.

description:

A recent law school graduate goes missing weeks before the bar exam; family, friends and investigators collaborate to solve the mystery of her disappearance; a revelation puts her inner circle of friends under suspicion.

title: Good Cop Bad Cop
description:
S01 E01 — Hunting Ground
Fear grips San Diego after police find a murdered woman's body tossed over a highway bridge. Investigators are led to a suspect that shocks everyone.

title: Good Cop Bad Cop
description:
S01 E04 — Blind Spot
Investigating a murder is hard enough, but when detectives realize the killer knows how to stage a crime scene to throw them off, the job gets even more difficult.

title: Good Cop Bad Cop
description:
S01 E02 — Handcuffs
A city's worst fear comes to fruition when the body of a University of Toledo sorority sister turns up riddled with bullets on campus; the ensuing investigation's findings shock the community and test the public's faith in law enforcement.

title: Good Cop Bad Cop
description:
S01 E06 — Hunting the Hunter
Calls flood into Silverton PD dispatch about a man shooting Rashawn Berry in broad daylight and fleeing the scene. A key piece of surveillance footage on the killer's escape route shows that a broken heart could be at the center of this violent act.

title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
description:
S01 E02 — I Deserve to Live, They Don't
From police officers to pastors, doctors to business leaders, they are the pillars of communities; when power seduces and corrupts, it opens the door to evil, and some will stop at nothing, even murder, to protect themselves.

title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
description:
S01 E01 — Bodies of Evidence
Larry Nassar becomes the go-to doctor for treating injured gymnasts after he helps the USA win Olympic gold; young women flock to him for rehabilitation; it takes years before the true cost of his medal-winning techniques comes to light.

title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
description:
S01 E03 — Blood Badge
A respected police Lieutenant, Billy Fields, fails to solve the murder of a young mother; years later, the reason why becomes clear.

title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
description:
S01 E04 — The Pain-Killer
When the medical board strikes off popular Arkansas pain doctor Randeep Mann amid allegations about his practice, they also uncover a monster; he stops at nothing to regain his practice, unleashing an explosive plot to regain power.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S17 E05 — I Died for a Moment
Desiray is lost and vulnerable when she meets Ray; he seems kind and understanding; Ray lures her into his trap, revealing his violence and cruelty; Desiray finds herself trapped in a living hell and must fight like hell to survive.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S16 E08 — A Demon on Her Back
Kayla's mother pays a hefty price when she breaks free of her husband Richard; he plots a final and brutal revenge.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S16 E07 — Greed, Jealousy, Malice
When Sara learns of her mother's murder, she slowly begins to realize who her father truly is, unearthing her family's dirty secrets along the way.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S16 E05 — My Wicked Stepmother
After her father, Donald Hoop, meets a woman named Joy, Desiree's life spirals; Joy is hot-tempered, cruel and controlling; Desiree knows her dad can't escape his toxic marriage, but she has no clue that Joy is orchestrating a cold-blooded murder.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S10 E02 — He Got Into My Soul
Christian Fuhr receives a life sentence, and his girlfriend, Ammie Turos, believes he is innocent; when she discovers he's guilty, her conviction is replaced by uncertainty, and she wonders if her life had been in danger the entire time.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

When Roger's best friend, Bob Duke, asks for a favor, he thinks Bob is venting; when he asks again, Roger worries about Bob's wife and son; after an accident occurs, Roger knows his friend is a killer.

description:

On the eve of a dream wedding, police find a mother of three dead at home in an apparent home invasion; as alibis fray and egos collide, authorities call in Texas Ranger Jim Holland, who'll use patience and tactics to expose what really happened.

In 2015, the East Coast experiences the first major terrorist attack since 9/11. The FBI carries out an intense 72-hour investigation with multiple bombings across New Jersey and New York. Now, they race to track down the bomber and save thousands.

title: 48 Hours

The case of a softball coach accused of recruiting a former player to kill her ex-boyfriend.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E07 — I've Got A Criminal Mind
A killer brutally murders an elderly couple, and detectives quickly focus on their 17-year-old grandson who lives with them; when they finally capture him, they uncover a charismatic young psychopath with a hunger for fast food and revenge.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E08 — I Wanted To Keep Her
When a grandmother vanishes, her grandson spins a twisted narrative about her demise and the disturbing location of her body inside a freezer; it doesn't take long for detectives to uncover the killer responsible, a parasitic psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E09 — I Had Everybody Fooled
When a mother, covered in blood and holding a barely breathing newborn, arrives at the hospital, medical staff uncover a faked birth.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:

Weeks after Christmas, police find a wife and her three young children decomposing in their beds; her husband is alive yet despondent; what appears to be a mass suicide later proves to be a murder orchestrated by a psychopathic family annihilator.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E11 — Something Took Control of Me
When a psychopathic husband kills his young wife and leaves her decapitated head in a bathtub, detectives question him about the crime; they realize they are confronting a malingering psychopath with control issues.

For the first time, insiders reveal dark secrets behind the #1 talk show.

Some young actors are led to make a life-altering career change after they step out of the spotlight: adult entertainment; Dan Benson ("Wizards of Waverly Place"), Maitland Ward ("Boy Meets World") and Scott Schwartz open up about their careers.

description:

In the early 1970s, Washington D.C. is terrorized by a cunning killer who abducts and murders six young African American girls; police and the community are outraged by the serial killings that target young children in their own neighborhoods.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:

Hot Snakes Media uncovers Benjaman Kyle's disturbing secrets, dark-web activity, erased files, and ties to the Burger Chef killings, before DNA reveals he's William Powell, a man hiding a past more sinister than imagined.

A new romance between two college students derails when a sadist attacks them during a nighttime walk by the railroad tracks; only one of them lives, and she turns out to be the sole survivor of a serial murderer known as the Railroad Killer.
